newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent futures down on API in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent futures down on API in thin trade.

text.p: SIMEX Brent crude futures traded lower late on Wednesday in a thin market on bearish American Petroleum Institute (API) distillate stocks data, brokers said.
They said the market lacked direction in typically dull year-end trading.

One broker said the market has largely discounted the strike at French Elf Aquitaine's refineries unless the oil workers extend their week-long strike for another week and unless the action spread to the country's Shell and Esso plants.

January last traded at $23.60 a barrel, down 17 cents from the previous close in London of $23.77, after registering 26 lots. February was untraded with quotes at $22.90/$23.00 from the IPE's close of $23.12.
NYMEX January crude on the after-hours ACCESS system last traded at $24.76, 17 cents below its last official close but up from a low of $24.65.
